description: Frozen output of the Python Fourier radial filter (basis/filtering.py, numpy + scipy spherical_jn) taken on 2026-10-30 before it was ported to Rust. Inputs: PAW-LCAO lda-sr pseudo waves (first valence state of each channel l <= 2; H, C, O, Si stored, Cu, Ag, Au, Pt read from the library and checked against input_fingerprint), a diffuse function, and r^l exp(-a r^2) on three meshes. Outputs: a fingerprint for every case, the whole array where output_key is set.

library_refreeze.what: the 24 cases read from the library (Cu, Ag l0-l2 at k 2, 3.5, 5; Au, Pt l0-l2 at k 3.5): n, info, input_fingerprint and output
library_refreeze.why: the library was regenerated (file format 3, 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-16); the pseudo waves these cases read moved (Cu l0 sum 868.77 -> 849.36), so the 2026-10-30 Python numbers no longer describe the input
library_refreeze.route: self-pin of the production routine on the installed library (Rust through the public Python API of the module under test); the old Python outputs of these cases are no longer reproducible because the library was regenerated
